text.p:
The API Connection Monitor shows the current status of connections to the $PNAME API, which allow other tools to communicate with $PNAME.
This is for instance used by the "Percepio Trace Exporter" plugin for Eclipse (found in the Eclipse marketplace) and for Atmel Studio 7 (found in the Microchip Gallery).

When the monitor is running, a status icon will be shown at the bottom right corner of the main $PNAME window. The color is green if connected, yellow if trying to connect, and red if there are problems with the connection.
If using our Eclipse or Atmel Studio plugin, it is possible to request a snapshot from the target directly, provided it is possible to do inside Eclipse or Atmel Studio.
The $PNAME API also allows for tool partners to integrate with $PNAME. Details can be provided on request.
